content.notes: Line 1 hook: du alone in the evening living room, title NUR FRAGEN – EINEN TAG LANG builds 0.2–2.2 s.

action.notes: Title then question marks float in, zipper closes the mouth at ~2.2 s: 'not allowed to talk about yourself' reads without narration.

motion.notes: Push-in, smile→zipped mouth swap clean; ? marks drift; no anatomy issues.

composition.notes: Medium shot, head ~r150, title y<300 clear of subtitles; bookshelf, window, lamp, sofa, plant, mug foreground.

content.notes: 'sondern nur Fragen stellen' – close-up of du with zipped mouth.

action.notes: Yellow ? speech bubble pops from the zipped mouth area at ~4.1–4.3 s.

motion.notes: Bubble scales in with overshoot, eyes look up; head steady with push.

composition.notes: Close-up r~280, bubble upper right in free space, readable.

content.notes: Line 2a: by evening you know more about people around you – roommate, du, colleague side by side.

action.notes: Thought bubbles with the roommate's exam paper and the colleague's mountains pop and grow, showing learned stories.

motion.notes: Bubbles grow 7.0–8.6 s; idle blinks; characters stable on legs.

composition.notes: Medium shot of three, faces y~350–420 of 640 thumb; bubbles readable, clear of subtitle.

content.notes: 'Und sie würden dich mehr mögen' – same trio.

action.notes: Roommate and colleague squeeze eyes happily, two hearts pop above them.

motion.notes: Smile change and heart pop are continuous; mug and key foreground.

composition.notes: Medium shot, hearts in free space above heads.

timing.notes: Happy faces ~9.6 s, hearts by 9.8 s on 'mögen' (9.64).

content.notes: Line 3: morning in the kitchen, roommate says he slept badly.

action.notes: MORGENS card, du walks in from right, roommate tired with mouth opening (speaking) ~12.5 s.

motion.notes: Walk-in from right edge to place is continuous; roommate mouth talk.

composition.notes: Bright kitchen: window, plants, fridge, pans, clock, coffee machine; cups/croissant foreground. Card top.

content.notes: 'dass er schlecht geschlafen hat' – close-up of tired roommate.

action.notes: Hand rises to rub the eye at 'geschlafen' and goes down again.

motion.notes: Grey sleeve arm rises from shoulder to the eye and drops by 15.27 s; no detached limbs.

composition.notes: Close-up r~290, warm morning light, readable subtitle.

content.notes: Line 4: usual reply 'Ich auch, ich war bis zwei Uhr wach.' – today not allowed.

action.notes: Speech bubble with the reply pops at 'Ich auch' (16.26, custom sample 16.0/16.8), gets red-crossed at 18.6, du's mouth zips.

motion.notes: Bubble pop, red X and fade are continuous; zipper swaps in cleanly.

composition.notes: Two-shot, bubble upper right readable, kitchen foreground props.

content.notes: Line 5: 'Also fragst du: Was hält dich gerade wach?'

action.notes: Zipper opens to a smile, yellow question bubble with the exact quote pops ~20.9 s.

motion.notes: Mouth zipper→smile, slight head tilt; bubble overshoot.

composition.notes: Close-up of du, bubble upper left, readable.

content.notes: Line 6a: 'Er setzt sich hin und erzählt' – roommate sits on a chair.

action.notes: Roommate lowers onto the chair (eyes close briefly), then a warm speech bubble with lines appears and grows.

motion.notes: Sit-down is visible against the chair; bubble grows 23.2→24.3 s.

composition.notes: Two-shot, chair left, kitchen background; bubble clear.

content.notes: 'zum ersten Mal von seiner Angst vor der Prüfung' – close-up roommate.

action.notes: Smile turns to worried frown, thought bubble 'Prüfung …' appears.

motion.notes: Expression swap and bubble pop continuous; push-in.

composition.notes: Close-up, bubble above head readable.

content.notes: Line 7: lunch break, colleague tells about her weekend in the mountains.

action.notes: MITTAGSPAUSE card, colleague (bun, purple) talks, mountain picture bubble pops on 'Bergen'.

motion.notes: Card scales in, bubble pops ~29.8 s; idle blink between (custom 27.2/28.4 checked).

composition.notes: Office canteen two-shot, windows, counter props, table edge foreground.

content.notes: Line 8a: you want to tell about your own holiday.

action.notes: Your own bubble 'Mein Urlaub am Meer war …' pops, red cross, zipper on mouth.

motion.notes: Smile → zipped mouth, X stroke and fade continuous.

composition.notes: Close-up of du, bubble upper centre, readable.

content.notes: 'Stattdessen fragst du: Was war der schönste Moment?'

action.notes: Yellow question bubble with exact quote pops from du; colleague leans/looks.

motion.notes: Bubble overshoot, colleague head tilt; no jumps.

composition.notes: Two-shot, bubble top centre, readable.

content.notes: Line 9a: 'Sie strahlt und redet zehn Minuten lang.'

action.notes: Colleague close-up beams (happy squint), mountain bubble grows, 10 MIN chip appears.

motion.notes: Squint/grin cycle, bubble growth continuous.

composition.notes: Close-up, bubble and chip in top half, readable.

content.notes: 'Am Ende sagt sie: Mit dir kann man so gut reden.'

action.notes: Her speech bubble with the quote pops, then a heart above du.

motion.notes: Bubble pop and heart pop clean.

composition.notes: Two-shot, bubble upper left readable.

timing.notes: Bubble at 39.6 on 'Mit' (39.48); heart after the quote.

content.notes: Line 10: 'Dabei hast du fast nichts gesagt.'

action.notes: du smiles with closed eyes, zipper reappears on the mouth at 'nichts'.

motion.notes: Calm push-in, smile → zipper swap.

composition.notes: Close-up du, clean.

content.notes: Line 11: Harvard researchers measured exactly that.

action.notes: HARVARD title, researcher with clipboard (hand dot at its corner), green tick appears on the sheet.

motion.notes: Clipboard stays in the hand; tick draws in by 45.27.

composition.notes: Campus with clock tower, trees, path; title top; readable.

content.notes: Line 12: speed dating, people asking more follow-up questions got a second date more often (Huang et al. 2017).

composition.notes: Café two-shot with name tags, menu board, lamps; labels readable top.

content.notes: Line 13a: talking about ourselves feels like a reward (Tamir & Mitchell 2012).

action.notes: A generic speaker (now green top, no accessory, so not confused with Tom or the roommate) talks; a golden star glows inside his head on 'Belohnung'.

motion.notes: Talk mouth cycle, star pop with glow, happy squint at end.

composition.notes: Close-up in café, star in head readable.

content.notes: Line 13b: about a third of conversations are about ourselves.

action.notes: Pie chart fills a yellow third on 'Drittel', ≈1/3 and ÜBER SICH SELBST appear; speaker's head (green-top speaker from shot 19) in the slice.

motion.notes: Fill sweeps 54.7→55.5 s smoothly; text pops.

composition.notes: Centred chart on blurred café, text above subtitle, readable.

motion.notes: Arm raises phone continuously 57.7→60.3 s, phone stays in hand.

composition.notes: Evening living room, lamp light; bubble readable.

action.notes: Old-photo bubble (person with bicycle) grows, clock spins, timer jumps to 1:04:10 and +1 STUNDE chip.

motion.notes: Clock hands spin, bubble grows; phone held.

content.notes: Line 17: you don't have to stop telling about yourself.

action.notes: Warm rim light, du smiles calmly (simple shot).

composition.notes: Medium two-shot, bubble top right readable.

content.notes: Line 18b: and really listen to the answer.

composition.notes: Close-up, label y~1340 just above subtitles, readable.

hook.notes: 0–3 s: title NUR FRAGEN – EINEN TAG LANG, floating ? marks and zipper mouth make the premise visible before the first cut at 2.87 s.

continuity.notes: Roommate (curly, grey knit), du (teal hoodie), colleague (bun, purple), dad (glasses, moustache on phone) consistent across sets; round 3 changed the shot 19/20 speaker from curly+blue (looked like Tom with new hair) to green top without accessory. Cut sheets 1–5 readable.

pacing.notes: 27 shots over 77 s alternating medium/close/graphic, 4 places (living room, kitchen, office, café/campus); no idle stretch above ~4 s in custom samples.
